body_priority_boundary_zh: 初筛列出的3篇优先正文问题中，本报告只补读 EmoReward 和 SleuthVLM。PyRUA-DataFarm 未由本审阅者补读正文；初筛文件保留原历史状态。

items.title: EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
items.source_version_boundary: Official unversioned HTML URL was observed at the recorded time. No v1 date or version is inferred from the HTML URL; official metadata is tracked separately.
sections_read: 第3节 Method（全部提取段落）
附录A Limitations and Future Work（全部提取段落）
附录E Evolve: RewardMemory Construction and Use（全部提取段落）

mechanism_checklist.agent_runtime_present: 文章以 Plan/Act/Reflect/Evolve 描述奖励系统；该命名本身不足以证明 Agent 自身执行程序被改写。
mechanism_checklist.changed_object: 由完成的参考训练轨迹估计提供者可靠性，形成奖励融合权重/倍率数值表；生成器训练另外更新模型参数。
mechanism_checklist.feedback: 有。参考运行的提供者分数与 VideoAlign outcome 的相关性用于校准奖励分配。
mechanism_checklist.retention: 有。导出的表在后续训练中固定查询和复用。
mechanism_checklist.own_reusable_harness_modification: 未见。所读方法和限制未展示 Agent 改写自己的提示词、工具、控制程序、验证/改进策略并继承接受版本。
mechanism_checklist.validation_and_inheritance: 有参考到校准训练的实验比较与奖励表继承；未展示候选 Harness 修改的验收和跨任务版本谱系。
mechanism_checklist.co_evolution_check: 未因含模型训练而直接排除；另外检查外部工件，实际改变的是训练奖励表，按 taxonomy 属 data_task。
mechanism_checklist.sustained_rsi: 未演示持续多代，附录A明确只有一次 reference-to-calibrated transition。

evidence.quote: These controls are computed, not learned (Appendix D ).
evidence.interpretation_zh: 当前证据门控为预设计算规则。

evidence.quote: EmoReward uses the fixed table produced by Evolve.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 跨训练运行复用的是奖励分配表。

evidence.quote: The table is fixed throughout the next training run: only the generator receives gradient updates, and runtime lookup neither re-estimates reliability nor writes back to the table.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 下一次训练期间表固定，只有生成器接受梯度更新。

evidence.quote: EmoReward studies a training-adaptive reward system that transfers evidence about provider reliability between generator-training runs without updating reward-model parameters.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 确有跨运行反馈转移，但对象为生成器训练奖励分配。

evidence.quote: Our experiments evaluate a reference-to-calibrated transition, not sustained improvement across many generations.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 实验证据只覆盖一次参考运行到校准运行的转移。

evidence.quote: The ordinal study reported here evaluates outputs; it does not implement this proposed feedback mechanism.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 模型层人工反馈是未来方案，当前输出评价未实现。

evidence.quote: Panel C illustrates this multiply-and-normalize step using recorded scores and illustrative starting weights: it is a controlled replay, not an additional training run.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 图7C的受控回放不能计为额外训练或演化代次。

items.reason_zh: 奖励系统确实把完成训练的反馈转成下一次训练复用的数值校准表，不能说没有反馈或没有持久化；但改变对象是训练奖励分配（data_task），所读正文未展示 Agent 自身可复用 Harness 的修改、验收与继承，因此建议排除当前 Harness 发布范围。

items.title: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
items.source_version_boundary: Official unversioned HTML URL was observed at the recorded time. No v1 date or version is inferred from the HTML URL; official metadata is tracked separately.
sections_read: 第3节 Method（全部提取段落）
第4.1节 Implementation details 段落
第9节 Implementation details（全部提取段落）
第13节 Sandbox rules and trajectory audit（全部提取段落）

mechanism_checklist.agent_runtime_present: 有。VLM 通过工具动态查找视频证据，并决定本题何时回答。
mechanism_checklist.changed_object: 单题的对话历史、检索窗口、采样间隔、工具输出和轨迹；系统提示词、操作指南及守卫规则固定。
mechanism_checklist.feedback: 有任务内工具返回与拒绝原因；未见候选 Harness 工件的评估反馈驱动后续程序修订。
mechanism_checklist.retention: 日志和本题上下文保留；每题独立内存 sandbox。所读正文未展示修改后的 Harness 版本跨题继承。
mechanism_checklist.own_reusable_harness_modification: 未见。正文明确作用域和操作指南在每个 benchmark 相同。
mechanism_checklist.validation_and_inheritance: 报告性能评测和 sandbox 审计，但未展示自动生成 Harness 候选、验收并部署为继承版本的闭环。
mechanism_checklist.co_evolution_check: 本判断基于固定 Harness 与任务态变化的区分，不依赖是否训练模型。
mechanism_checklist.sustained_rsi: 未展示。动态推理/工具执行不等同持续程序演化。

evidence.quote: The harness consists of a scope definition, which fixes what the model can access and do, and an operating guide, which suggests how to gather evidence; both are part of the system prompt and are the same on every benchmark.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 同一固定系统提示词包括作用域和操作指南。

evidence.quote: The model decides which steps a question needs.
evidence.interpretation_zh: Agent 自主选择本题的证据收集动作。

evidence.quote: The model takes these steps on its own; the harness prescribes no window or interval.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 本题窗口/间隔调整是执行时选择，不等同改写 Harness。

evidence.quote: Earlier reasoning stays in the history, so prompts only grow and the prefix cache is reused; when a prompt exceeds 110k tokens, the oldest images are dropped from it.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 历史和固定裁剪规则是运行状态与既定策略。

evidence.quote: Each question gets its own sandbox in memory, with a muted copy of the video, and every command is logged.
evidence.interpretation_zh: sandbox 的边界是单个问题。

evidence.quote: Before a command runs, a guard checks it against fixed rules
evidence.interpretation_zh: 安全守卫执行固定规则。

evidence.quote: Every bash command and its output are written to the result file, and every refused command is kept with its reason.
evidence.interpretation_zh: 轨迹与拒绝原因会保存，但未展示由其驱动 Harness 修改与继承。

items.reason_zh: 文章有真实 Agent Harness，但正文明确系统提示词中的作用域和指南在各 benchmark 固定，守卫规则固定，每题单独 sandbox。动态证据查找、工具反馈和增长的历史属于任务执行状态，未见 Agent 修改可复用 Harness 并验收继承，建议按 static_framework 排除。
